```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r}
library(DESeq2)
library(TxDb.Dmelanogaster.UCSC.dm6.ensGene)
library(tximport)
library(tximportData)
library(rhdf5)
library(gplots)
library(ggplot2)
library(RColorBrewer)
library("AnnotationDbi")
library("org.Dm.eg.db")  # For Drosophila melanogaster Dm
library(clusterProfiler)
```

## Part 2- Differential expression analysis of L2 Vs L3

##### Loading the data

Load the data, stored as kallisto tpm (transcript per million counts), by specifying the path and using the tximportData package. The sample file need to be formatted to have columns with appropriate sample identities. Below are the description of the functions used from "tximport" to read the count tables from kallisto.

```{r}
#setwd("/Volumes/STORAGE1/Analysis_Silies_lab")
samples <- read.table(file.path(".", "samples_silies_L2_L3.txt"), header = TRUE)
files_silies_L2_L3 <- file.path(".", "Kallisto_combined", samples$run, "abundance.tsv")
names(files_silies_L2_L3) <- c("L2_rep1","L2_rep2", "L3_rep1", "L3_rep2")
files_silies_L2_L3
txi.kallisto.L2_L3.tsv <- tximport(files_silies_L2_L3, type = "kallisto", tx2gene = tx2gene, ignoreAfterBar = TRUE)
sampleTable <- data.frame(condition = factor(rep(c("A", "B"), each = 2)))
rownames(sampleTable) <- colnames(txi.kallisto.L2_L3.tsv$counts)
```
Now I would run DESeq2 on the data, which will perform the differential analysis. This would report all the results without the pvalue and fold change filtering.

```{r}
dds_kallisto_silies_L2_L3 <- DESeqDataSetFromTximport(txi.kallisto.L2_L3.tsv, sampleTable, ~condition)
dds_kallisto_silies_L2_L3 <- dds_kallisto_silies_L2_L3[ rowSums(counts(dds_kallisto_silies_L2_L3)>1)>=2 ]
rld_silies_L2_L3 <- rlog(dds_kallisto_silies_L2_L3)
dds_silies_L2_L3 <- DESeq(dds_kallisto_silies_L2_L3)
res_silies_L2_L3 <- results(dds_silies_L2_L3)
```
#### MA-Plot

From the DESeq2 vignette: The function plotMA shows the log2 fold changes attributable to a given variable over the mean of normalized counts for all the samples in the DESeqDataSet. Points will be colored red if the adjusted p value is less than 0.1. Points which fall out of the window are plotted as open triangles pointing either up or down.

```{r plotMA, echo=TRUE}
plotMA(results(dds_silies_L2_L3, alpha = 0.01))
```

```{r}
res_silies_L2_L3Ordered <- res_silies_L2_L3[order(res_silies_L2_L3$pvalue),]
write.table(as.data.frame(res_silies_L2_L3Ordered), file="./data_for_tidyverse/L2_Vs_L3_DeSeq2_new.csv", sep = "\t")
counts_siiles_L2_L3 <- txi.kallisto.L2_L3.tsv$counts
colnames(counts_siiles_L2_L3)
write.table(counts_siiles_L2_L3, file = "./data_for_tidyverse/tpm_counts_silies_L2_L3.txt", sep = "\t", row.names = T)
 # Filter out rows with NAs in the Lof2FC column
filtered_df <- res_silies_L2_L3Ordered %>% filter(!is.na(log2FoldChange))

# Filter out rows with pvalues > 0.05
filtered_df <- res_silies_L2_L3Ordered %>% filter(pvalue <= 0.05)


# Filter rows with log2 fold change >= 0.6 or <= -0.6
filtered_df <- res_silies_L2_L3Ordered %>% filter(log2FoldChange >= 0.6 | log2FoldChange <= -0.6)
                                                  

# Save the filtered dataframe to a new file

print("The filtered file with pvalues <= 0.05 has been saved as 'L2_Vs_L3_DeSeq2_filtered_pvalue.txt'.")


 # Save the filtered dataframe to a new file
write.table(filtered_df, file = "./analysis_neel/L2_Vs_L3_DeSeq2_filtered.txt", sep = "\t", row.names = TRUE)
 
print("The filtered file without NAs has been saved as 'L2_Vs_L3_DeSeq2_filtered.txt'.")
```
```{r}
res <- as.data.frame(filtered_df)

#Keytype ='FLYBASE" as IDs are FBgnIDs
res$symbol <- mapIds(org.Dm.eg.db, 
                     keys=row.names(res), 
                     column="SYMBOL", 
                     keytype="FLYBASE",
                     multiVals="first")

res$entrez <- mapIds(org.Dm.eg.db, 
                     keys=row.names(res), 
                     column="ENTREZID", 
                     keytype="FLYBASE",
                     multiVals="first")

res$name =   mapIds(org.Dm.eg.db,
                    keys=row.names(res), 
                    column="GENENAME",
                    keytype="FLYBASE",
                    multiVals="first")
write.csv(res, file = "L2_Vs_L3_res_GO.csv")





BiocManager::install("clusterProfiler")
library(clusterProfiler)
gene_to_test <- rownames(filtered_df)
gene_to_test
GO_results <- enrichGO(gene = gene_to_test, OrgDb = "org.Dm.eg.db", keyType = "ENSEMBL", ont = "BP") # "BP" Biological process, "MF" Molecular function, "CC" cellular component
fit <-plot(barplot(GO_results, showCategory = 20))
fit
write.csv(GO_results, file = "L2_Vs_L3_GO_results_BP.csv")

GO_results <- enrichGO(gene = gene_to_test, OrgDb = "org.Dm.eg.db", keyType = "FLYBASE", ont = "MF")
fit <-plot(barplot(GO_results, showCategory = 20))
fit

write.csv(GO_results, file = "L2_Vs_L3_GO_results_MF.csv")
```

Having done the global evaluation of the data
